aliases: Morgan County Data Center Project I

location.site_description: SR-42/Keller Hill Road area east of Monrovia; reporting describes boundaries as Keller Hill Road to the north, North Antioch Road to the east, Indiana 42 to the south, and West Union Church Road to the west.

actions.exact_result_status: Google's Indiana location page lists Morgan County as a 2025 announced data center location and a site currently in development; local/trade reporting on 2025-10-21/2025-10-22 reported Google's public confirmation of the Morgan County opportunity.
actions.access_caveat: Company source, not a government approval; page gives the announcement year but not an exact day, municipality, parcel, capacity, permit, or vote.

actions.exact_result_status: Commissioner minutes state Ordinance 2025-1 concerned a PUD district rezone request for a data center, received a 7-1 favorable Plan Commission recommendation, and was approved by the Commissioners.
actions.access_caveat: Official county minutes are text-extractable; the ordinance PDF itself is image/scanned text in this environment.

actions.exact_result_status: Commissioner minutes state the county accepted a Banning Engineering professional engineering services agreement for inspection and plan-review services for new development project 'Louie' on SR-42, plus a developer cost-reimbursement agreement.
actions.access_caveat: Official county minutes; the minutes do not name Google in the same action item.

actions.exact_result_status: Commissioner minutes describe Keller Hill Road damage caused by data center construction traffic; the data center company voluntarily milled and rebuilt damaged sections, and county staff requested a formal agreement for future damage.
actions.access_caveat: Official county minutes; supports active site-work status but is not a building permit.

actions.exact_result_status: County administrator reported discussions with Google representatives for a road-use agreement around their Keller Hill Road job site, and said the county would draft a proposed agreement.
actions.access_caveat: Official county minutes; confirms Google representatives and a Keller Hill Road job site.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.summary: Official county/company sources reviewed do not disclose a firm MW capacity. Public trackers/media claims include 390 MW and 1200 MW, so capacity remains null pending primary utility/regulatory evidence.

Sources distinguish the original roughly 391-acre PUD/rezone from later expansion reporting around 500-plus/550 acres and a local article citing 628 acres after additional land purchases; no single acreage is promoted to a primary field.
